[[Hells Eagles]] |terminal =[[The Core terminal entries]] |cell name =TheCraterCore01 |refid ={{ID|0040A2C1}} }} '''The Core''', also known as '''the Crater Core''', is a [[Fallout 76 locations#Wastelanders|location]] within [[the Crater]] in the [[Toxic Valley]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== The Crater Core is the remains of the center of the crashed ''Valiant-1'' space station. Before crashing, the space station resembled a wheel; the hub and spokes of that wheel form the upper level of the Core. [[Meg Groberg]] can be found in the center hub, while [[Gail]], [[Ra-Ra]], [[Caleb Fisher]], and [[Johnny Weston]] can be found wandering around their rooms in the spokes of the Core. A central spiral staircase leads down to a den of excavated rooms. [[Surge]], [[Barb (Wastelanders)|Barb]], [[Lev]], and the [[raider punk]] can be found in this area. [[Lucky Lou|Lou]] will also return to this area after the [[Fallout 76 quests|quest]] [[Cheating Death]] is completed. Surge, Lev, and Fisher will leave once [[From Russia With Lev]] is started. [[Weasel]] and [[Mortimer (Wastelanders)|Mortimer]] will inhabit the area following the completion of [[Secrets Revealed]], although Weasel will only appear if the raiders version of the quest is completed while Mortimer will appear regardless. The raiders salvaged some kind of large projector or transmitter from the wreckage, which [[Caleb Fisher|Caleb]] called the "Space Beam," and [[Munch]] called the "Angel Piss project."'''Space Beam'''

I'm not sure what sort of work they were doing up on the space station, but I dug into some of the surviving documents.

This thing they were building. It's not like anything I've seen before. Is it communications? A weapon? I don't know. There's a lot of missing information.

I've decided to call it the "Space Beam," for lack of better words. Munch wanted to call it the "Angel Piss Project," of course, but I quickly put an end to that.

It could be years before I figure it all out, let alone get it running."
([[The Core terminal entries#Space Beam|Crater Core terminal entries, Space Beam]]) ==Notable loot== * [[Lou's goodbye note]] - Note, can be found on a table in Lou's room in the Crater only during [[Cheating Death]]. * [[Cigar (Fallout 76)|Lit cigar]] in an ashtray on a desk, in the tube to the right of the [[gold press machine]]. * [[A lead at last]] - Given by [[Oscar Gonzalez]] after starting the quest [[Hells Eagles]]. ==Notes== * A number of details at this location seem to relate to the [[Cult of the Mothman]]. ** A partially-buried [[Art deco sculptures|art deco sculpture]] can be seen here, wrapped in roots. No text or dialogue acknowledges it. ** The only [[Mounted creature (Fallout 76)|taxidermied mothman]] in the game is found in Meg's quarters. *** Meg has no obvious affiliation with the occult, and the Core is full of animal remains in general. ** A set of [[whale bones]] is displayed above the gold press machine in the style typical to [[Mothman]] [[Cult of the Mothman#Locations|shrines]]. *** Munch identifies the bones as belonging to a whale.[[A Whale of a Tale]] *** Outside, a set of [[whale bones]] is laid out atop [[Ae-Ri]]'s workspace. **The symmetrical human chandelier seen here is typical of cult architecture, especially as seen at [[Clancy Manor]]. ** An owl shooting target can be found in the basement, identical to one seen in [[Point Pleasant]]. The cult often incorporate pre-War owl knick-knacks in their shrines. ** [[Creed]], an NPC within the Core, mentions that [[Cult of the Mothman|the Cult of the Mothman]] sees the Raiders' turf as their rightful holy land.A [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"What do you know about the Cult of the Mothman?"''
[[Creed]]: ''"{{Tooltip|Bunch of psychos in robes. They think our turf is some kind of holy land, and they'll risk death to protect it.|Derisive}} That's{{sic}} suits me just fine, I'll throw down with those nutjobs anytime, anywhere. {{Tooltip|I heard they've settled in over at Point Pleasant. Maybe we should pay them a not-so-friendly visit, you know what I mean?|Sinister intent, maybe with an evil chuckle at the end.}}"''
([[Creed/Dialogue|Creed's dialogue]]) *** There was no obvious indication of cult activity at the original version of the crashed space station. A small abandoned shrine ravaged by plant growth could be found to the south, but the site has since disappeared. ==Appearances== The Core appears only {{In|FO76WL}}. ==Behind the scenes== The space station is based directly on the design of [[Ballistic Orbital Missile Base 001|B.O.M.B.-001]] and the premise of [[Ballistic Orbital Missile Base 002|B.O.M.B.-002]] from ''[[Van Buren]]''. HornwrightEstateExt02-04 |edid =LocMountainsHornwrightEstateLocation |refid ={{ID|00263421}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |armor =yes |weapons =yes |tinkering =yes }} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeWealthy}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeResponderEyebot}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWealthy}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMountain}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleMedium}} }} '''Hornwright Estate''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the boundary between the [[Savage Divide]] and [[Ash Heap]] regions in [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== This estate is the seat of power of the Hornwright family, owners of the [[Hornwright Industrial|Hornwright Industrial Mining Company]]. It's a classic example of a [[Mega Mansion]], a marker of wealth in [[Bramwell]], on the edge of the [[Ash Heap]]. ==Layout== The ground floor contains traces of the [[automation riots|miner riots]] that swept through Appalachia shortly before the [[Great War]]. The bricked foyer contains a looted bar and a secure elevator leading up to the Mega Mansion and down to the estate safe room. The [[Hornwright Estate access keycard]] is located on the top floor executive level of the [[Hornwright Industrial headquarters]]. One can also be found inside the [[Hornwright summer villa]], on a cart in the basement. The estate has four floors in total, filled with loot and information about the Hornwrights. The lowest floor contains a helipad and the trophy room, directly opposite the elevator, with the kitchens just behind it. The western wing contains two master bedrooms, a great room, and a conference room, with the main dining room and lounge on the opposite end of the floor. The second floor, overlooking the first in the western and southern parts, contains [[Penelope Hornwright]]'s bedroom in the northwest, complete with a locked safe, and her office across, to the southeast. The guest bedrooms line the northern section of the floor, while the eastern part of the level contains the pool table room, gym, and lounge. Up the staircase flanking the pool table room lie the workshops used by the Hornwright family. The western chambers contain [[Weapons workbench (Fallout 76)|weapons]], [[Armor workbench (Fallout 76)|armor]], and [[tinker's workbench]]es, along with a plethora of robot parts, while the eastern part is a mechanic's room. The top deck contains the most representative part of the mansion, a great hall with a [[Stingray Deluxe (Fallout 76)|Stingray Deluxe]] suspended from the decorative ceiling, with an open-air swimming pool and jacuzzi baths on the end of the deck. This is where the [[Assaultron (Fallout 76)#Hornwright elite security|Hornwright elite security]] can be found, alongside two [[Protectron (Fallout 76)#Hornwright butler|Hornwright butlers]]. There is also a safe room built below the estate, accessible via the elevator, originally functioning as [[Daniel Hornwright]]'s private laboratory.[[Hornwright Estate terminal entries#Incoming Mail System - Entry 01|Hornwright Estate terminal entries; Penny Hornwright's terminal, Incoming Mail System - Entry 01]] It can only be accessed during the [[Fallout 76 quests|quest]] [[Trade Secrets]]. Inside the safe room is Penelope Hornwright herself, who only recently returned to her family's estate. A weapons workbench and a tinker's workbench can be found along the western wall. ==Notable loot== ;Holotapes and notes * [[Charleston Herald - Tragedy Hits Hornwright]] - In [[Evelyn Hornwright]]'s bedroom. * [[RSVP card]] - On the bar in the eastern second floor penthouse. * [[Hornwright Industrial notice]] - On a small table at the helipad. * [[Hornwright Estate lab key]] - Key, obtained during [[Trade Secrets]]. '''Marie''' is a [[Miss Nanny (Fallout 76)|Miss Nanny]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]] in [[Appalachia]], specifically the mall area of the resort.

==Background==
Marie is one of the dozen or so robotic vendors that replaced the human staff of the Whitespring shortly before the [[Great War]]. She resides in the Le Grand Gourmet store of the Whitespring mall area. She mainly sells various food items and related items to the player character.

Marie looks down on the [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dwellers]] for their poor cuisine.
